enhancements.text: When a Stratagem targets the bearer's unit, roll a D6; on 4+, gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Starflare Ignition System
enhancements.text: At the end of your opponent's turn, if the bearer's unit isn't in Engagement Range, it can be placed in Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Fail-safe Detonator
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a BATTLESUIT is destroyed
stratagems.effect: Its Deadly Demise roll is treated as a 6 (or 1); otherwise units within 6" take D3 mortal wounds on a 4+.

stratagems.name: Stimm Injectors
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after targets are selected
stratagems.effect: It has Feel No Pain 6+ until end of phase.

stratagems.name: The Shortened Blade
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase
stratagems.target: BATTLESUIT unit arriving by Deep Strike
stratagems.effect: Set it up more than 6" from all enemies; it cannot charge this turn.

stratagems.name: The Arro’kon Protocol
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase
stratagems.effect: Attacks against units with 6+ models gain SUSTAINED HITS 1; against units with 11+ models, SUSTAINED HITS 2.

stratagems.name: The Torchstar Gambit
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, after attacks resolve
stratagems.target: FLY BATTLESUIT not in Engagement Range
stratagems.effect: It may make a Normal move, then cannot charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Grav-inhibitor Field
stratagems.when: Opponent's Charge phase, after a charge is declared
stratagems.target: T'AU unit targeted by the charge
stratagems.effect: The charging enemy takes a Battle-shock test; each model in it rolls a D6, each 6 inflicts 1 mortal wound.

rule.name: Hunter's Instincts
rule.text: KROOT attacks get +1 to hit against units below Starting Strength, and +1 to wound against Below Half-strength units. Skirmish Fighters: KROOT have a 6+ invulnerable save against melee and 5+ against ranged attacks, and KROOT CARNIVORE units gain BATTLELINE.

enhancements.name: Borthrod Gland
enhancements.text: KROOT FLESH SHAPER leader. An unmodified 5+ melee Hit roll is a Critical Hit.

enhancements.name: Kroothawk Flock
enhancements.text: The bearer's unit's ranged weapons have IGNORES COVER; enemy Reinforcements can't arrive within 12" of the bearer.

enhancements.name: Nomadic Hunter
enhancements.text: KROOT TRAIL SHAPER leader. The unit gets +3" Move and its ranged weapons gain ASSAULT.

enhancements.name: Root-carved Weapons
enhancements.text: KROOT WAR SHAPER. All of the bearer's weapons gain PRECISION and DEVASTATING WOUNDS.

stratagems.name: Join the Hunt
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a KROOT INFANTRY or HOUNDS unit is destroyed
stratagems.effect: A new identical unit arrives from Strategic Reserves at Starting Strength. Once per battle.

stratagems.name: A Trap Well Laid
stratagems.when: Your Shooting or Fight phase
stratagems.effect: After its attacks, one enemy unit it hit has +1 Armour Penetration against KROOT attacks until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Emp Grenades
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after a VEHICLE is selected
stratagems.target: KROOT GRENADES unit within 8" of that VEHICLE
stratagems.effect: The enemy VEHICLE's Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill are worsened by 1.

stratagems.name: The Grisly Feast
stratagems.when: Fight phase
stratagems.target: KROOT unit that destroyed enemy units
stratagems.effect: In your opponent's next Command phase, enemy units within 6" take a Battle-shock test (-1 if Below Half-strength).

stratagems.name: Guerrilla Warriors
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, after a KROOT unit Falls Back
stratagems.effect: It can shoot and charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Hidden Hunters
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, after targets are selected
stratagems.effect: It can only be hit by ranged attacks from within 18".

rule.name: Expert Fieldcraft
rule.text: PATHFINDER TEAM and STEALTH BATTLESUITS shooting doesn't stop them being hidden.

enhancements.name: Negation Emitters
enhancements.text: The bearer's STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit has a -3" detection range.

enhancements.name: Unmasking Suite
enhancements.text: GHOSTKEEL, PATHFINDER or STEALTH unit. When it shoots, enemies within 24" get +9" detection range until it has shot.

stratagems.name: Marker Beacon
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase
stratagems.effect: Secure one objective it controls.

stratagems.name: Microdrone Support
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a unit starts an action
stratagems.effect: The action doesn't stop it being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: Autoreactive Camouflage
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, when targeting a hidden PATHFINDER or STEALTH unit
stratagems.effect: It gets +1 to its saving throw.

rule.name: Integrated Command Structure
rule.text: Friendly KROOT and VESPID STINGWINGS units get Harnessed Alien Instincts: in your Shooting phase, pick a visible enemy within 12" as prey-marked (+3" detection range). GHOSTKEEL and STEALTH units allow nearby KROOT and VESPID units within 6" to shoot without losing hidden status.

enhancements.name: Student of Kauyon
enhancements.text: KROOT SHAPER. In Declare Battle Formations, up to three KROOT CARNIVORES or FARSTALKERS units gain Deep Strike.

enhancements.name: Admired Leader
enhancements.text: Non-KROOT T'AU. In your Command phase, one KROOT or VESPID unit within 12" gets +1 Leadership and +1 OC until your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Experimental Modifications
stratagems.when: Your Shooting or Fight phase, when a KROOT or VESPID unit is selected to attack
stratagems.effect: Its attacks get +1 Armour Penetration.

stratagems.name: Alien Expertise
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a KROOT or VESPID unit is selected to Advance
stratagems.effect: Advancing doesn't stop it charging.

stratagems.name: Guided by Unity
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a non-KROOT/VESPID T'AU unit is selected to shoot
stratagems.effect: Its ranged attacks against units within 9" of a KROOT or VESPID unit have LETHAL HITS.

rule.name: Superior Craftsmanship
rule.text: BATTLESUIT CHARACTER ranged attacks get +6" Range.

enhancements.name: Thermoneutronic Projector
enhancements.text: In Declare Battle Formations, one Flamer weapon gets +2 Strength, +1 Armour Penetration and +1 Damage.

enhancements.name: Plasma Accelerator Rifle
enhancements.text: In Declare Battle Formations, one plasma rifle gets +2 Strength, +1 Attacks, +1 Armour Penetration and +1 Damage.

enhancements.name: Supernova Launcher
enhancements.text: In Declare Battle Formations, one airbursting fragmentation projector gets +3 Strength, +1 Armour Penetration and +1 Damage.

stratagems.name: Experimental Ammunition
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a BATTLESUIT CHARACTER is selected to shoot
stratagems.effect: Its ranged attacks get +1 Strength, or +1 Strength and +1 Armour Penetration with HAZARDOUS (choose one).

armyRules.name: For the Greater Good
armyRules.text: At the start of your Shooting phase, pick eligible units as Observers. Each eligible Observer marks one visible enemy unit as Spotted (each enemy can be marked once per phase). Units with this ability are Guided while targeting Spotted units, gaining +1 Ballistic Skill against them. If the Observer has MARKERLIGHT, those attacks also have IGNORES COVER.
